description: This SQL migration script creates tables, indexes, and functions related to PostgreSQL extensions for handling vector embeddings used in a job matching system. It defines tables for storing seeker and job embeddings, enables row-level security, and provides a helper function to find the top-k job matches for a given seeker based on cosine similarity.

methods.name: public.match_jobs_for_seeker
methods.description: A SQL function that retrieves the top-k job IDs with the highest cosine similarity to a seeker's embedding based on their user ID.

calls: from public.seekers_embeddings se join public.jobs_embeddings je on true
